objective: Frozen computation: 2,000 starts per size (n = 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20) under each of seven weightings frozen before classification (bare random trees; bare trees with one surplus distinction per knot at probability 25%, 50% and 100%; bare trees with Poisson(1) extra lines; knots added one at a time; a configuration model), classified by the proved class and the theorem's growth class, with a stratified regrowth.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (10 of 11 held; W7 failed; referee pending): read by the proved theorem, uniform random trees at bare sizes are all in the class and grow in three or more dimensions in 12% at twelve knots and 37% at twenty; with Poisson(1) extra lines exponential growth is 11-41% of in-class growers; the configuration model and growth by attachment keep two (80-100% of in-class growers, three never); 1,226 of 1,226 regrown agree round by round, 622 of them three-plus or exponential.
title: Seven weightings read by the proved theorem
